measured_bottleneck.diagnosis: A quote-and-punctuation token cycle bypassed the lexical guard and remained below the broad byte-repetition ceiling.

bounded_change.semantics: Reject only a candidate next token that would make an identical-token run exceed four; greedily choose the next-highest allowed token.
bounded_change.complexity: O(1) in generation length because at most the four immediately preceding token IDs are inspected

compute_policy.rationale: GPU owns ABI information acquisition; CPU is the required final LayerCake inference target.

required_successor_screen: Export one new native runtime from the exact v16 checkpoint with the hash-bound overlay.
Reverify core identity, teacher absence, canonical ABI identity, and physical sparse execution.
Rerun all 1,000 locked validation prompts, not only the failed prompt.
Require zero collapse and retain every prior functional, source-retention, and routing gate.
Only after those gates pass, run the preregistered 112-prompt paired GPU judge.
Run the full corrected synthetic suite, natural audit, and repeated CPU throughput, TTFT, and RSS certification on the same runtime.
Reject the successor if it falls below the locked 2x transformer CPU-speed gate or below 95% of the Phase-2 host throughput.
decision_rule: There is exactly one threshold and one successor runtime. No threshold sweep is permitted. Any validation regression or residual collapse rejects the repair and requires an architecture-level pivot, not another nearby decoder variant.
claim_boundary: This is a generic online safety control, not extracted English knowledge. It cannot provide fluency or quality credit; the independent paired judge, natural audit, and exact-runtime CPU gates remain controlling.
